notes.title: Welcome to Project Athenia!
notes.notes:
Hey Everyone,

Welcome to the fresh & official Steam page of [b]Project Athenia[/b], a First-Person Shooter, developed by me (paasmoo). The game will feature multiple game modes such as CTF or Bomb Defuse. It is currently planned to release in mid-2024 for free.


[b]Join the Discord for development updates and announcements![/b]
